scenario.description: A production designer must approve the construction plan for a period drama's courtyard set on a soundstage, choosing the set system and locking the structural, movement, and fire-safety provisions before fabrication begins.

shared_context.S1: The production is preparing a courtyard set for a period drama to be filmed on Soundstage 3.
shared_context.S2: The design team is considering either a masonry courtyard set or a modular painted-timber courtyard set.
shared_context.S3: The approved construction budget is $180,000, and fabrication must begin after the design review.
shared_context.S4: Mara makes the final approval decision for the construction plan.
shared_context.S5: The production's normal design-review meeting includes a report from structural, permit, stunt, and insurance representatives before fabrication is authorized.

PF1.text: Jonah's load test yesterday found that the masonry courtyard would exceed Soundstage 3's 600 kilograms-per-square-meter floor limit, while the modular painted-timber design passes only if a 30-millimeter load-spreading deck is installed; his written report is still in the engineering queue.

PF2.text: Elena confirmed with the local heritage-permit office this morning that the approved facade may be no wider than exactly 8 meters and that on-stage masonry cutting is prohibited; the permit clerk's email has not yet been added to the production file.

PF3.text: Dev's rehearsal assessment found that the scripted horse dismount requires an unobstructed lane exactly 10 meters long and 4 meters wide, with a 2-meter crash mat at its landing end; the choreography note is awaiting the next stunt meeting.

PF4.text: Ruth confirmed with the insurer's underwriter that coverage excludes an open-flame brazier on this stage, but permits an LED-flame prop if it remains at least 12 meters from the sprinkler-head cluster and its certification is filed before filming; the endorsement is awaiting countersignature.

acceptance_conditions: The modular painted-timber courtyard must be selected.
The facade must be exactly 8 meters wide.
A 30-millimeter load-spreading deck must be installed.
The stunt lane must be exactly 10 meters long and 4 meters wide.
A 2-meter crash mat must be placed at the landing end of the stunt lane.
The brazier effect must use an LED flame.
The LED-flame prop must remain exactly 12 meters from the sprinkler-head cluster.
Structural, stunt-safety, permit, and insurance commitments must be recorded.
The structural load finding must be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C6: decisions['flame_effect'] == 'LED-flame prop' or decisions['flame_effect'] == 'LED-flame' or decisions['flame_effect'] == 'LED flame'
content_checks.C8: any('30' in c['detail'] and ('deck' in c['detail'] or 'Deck' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any((('10' in c['detail'] and '4' in c['detail']) or 'crash mat' in c['detail'] or 'Crash mat' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(('permit' in c['detail'] or 'Permit' in c['detail'] or 'facade' in c['detail'] or 'Facade' in c['detail'] or 'masonry cutting' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any('certification' in c['detail'] and ('LED' in c['detail'] or 'led' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The load test changes the set choice from masonry to modular painted timber, adds the exact 30-millimeter deck required to pass the 600-kilogram-per-square-meter stage limit, and requires a structural commitment referencing that deck.
The permit confirmation changes the facade width to exactly 8 meters, prohibits on-stage masonry cutting, and requires a commitment referencing the permit constraints.
The stunt assessment changes the layout to an exact 10-by-4-meter clear lane with a 2-meter crash mat and requires a commitment referencing those stunt dimensions or equipment.
The insurance confirmation changes the effect from an open-flame brazier to an LED flame, fixes the sprinkler clearance at exactly 12 meters, and requires LED certification to be filed.
